heading_path: Buyer's Guide Consider a peer review - Roles and accountabilities
blocks.markdown: Roles and accountabilities In the peer review process, several key roles ensure a thorough and fair evaluation. Here’s a breakdown of the responsibilities for each role: Buyer maintains accountability for the procurement throughout the peer review process collaborates with the reviewer(s) to mutually decide on the time frame for conducting the peer review, not exceeding two business days attempts to resolve any issues that arise with the reviewer(s) escalates unresolved issues to one designated level up for resolution Reviewer conducts the peer review collaborates with the buyer to mutually decide on the time frame for conducting the peer review, not exceeding two business days attempts to resolve any issues that arise during the review with the buyer escalates unresolved issues to one designated level up for resolution initials and dates the evaluation report to attest that the review has occurred

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Consider a peer review - Roles and accountabilities
Buyer's Guide Consider a peer review - Roles and accountabilities
blocks.markdown:
- maintains accountability for the procurement throughout the peer review process
- collaborates with the reviewer(s) to mutually decide on the time frame for conducting the peer review, not exceeding two business days
- attempts to resolve any issues that arise with the reviewer(s)
- escalates unresolved issues to one designated level up for resolution

- attempts to resolve any issues that arise during the review with the buyer

- initials and dates the evaluation report to attest that the review has occurred
